narrationTexts: Confirmed shape. Now migrating all app files, skipping the vendored adapter.
finalText:
**Migration done.** 11 files moved from `db.query` to `db.execute({ sql, params })`:

`macroAdmin.js`, `sla.js`, `couponService.js`, `returnService.js`, `cohort.js`, `refund.js`, `variantAdmin.js`, `teamService.js`, `supplier.js`, `apiKeyAdmin.js`, `session.js`, `shipment.js`.

Only remaining `db.query` calls are in `[vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js)`, marked "do not edit — replaced wholesale on every upgrade." Left it alone.

Next: nothing, unless you want that vendor adapter wrapped separately.
